exposure: Smartphone application for gestational weight control
cohort: Overweight and obese primiparas (BMI ≥ 24 kg/m(2)) with age between 20 and 40 years old
finding: The use of a smartphone application for weight control during pregnancy was associated with a reduced rate of cesarean section in overweight and obese women.
mod_finding: The smartphone assisted weight control may help reduce CS rate.
